description: Unify workflow profile description source to YAML and delete the SuitableFor concept across server, CLI, and skill-data.

tasks.title: Server: unify description source via shared resolver and remove SuitableFor from the workflow-profile model
tasks.description: In packages/server, introduce a single shared description resolver (recommended: a static `MohistWorkflow.ResolveDescription(WorkflowDefinition)` applying the empty-value fallback and `.TrimEnd()`), then repoint `MohistGithubPrIssueWorkflowProfile.Description` to read `MohistWorkflow.GithubPrWorkflowDefinition.Description` (mirroring local) and repoint the github-pr branch of `ProjectWorkflowProfileManager.BuildSystemTemplates()` to read `WorkflowDefinition.Description` identically to the local branch. Delete the `MohistGithubPrIssueWorkflowProfile.GithubPrDescription` constant and all references. Remove `SuitableFor` from `IIssueWorkflowProfile`, `MohistIssueWorkflowProfileBase`, and both built-in profile overrides; drop it from the `WorkflowProfileDescription` DTO and `IssueWorkflowProfileRegistry.ListDescribed()`; delete `IssueWorkflowProfileRegistry.Matches()` and the entire `SuitableForMatcher.cs` file. Repoint/rewrite the affected server specs (description asserted against the YAML-sourced value with fallback; SuitableFor-positive assertions removed).
acceptanceCriteria: `dotnet build Mohist.sln` succeeds with `TreatWarningsAsErrors` (the server C# lint gate).
`MohistGithubPrIssueWorkflowProfile` declares no `GithubPrDescription` constant and no code path references such a constant (grep returns nothing).

`mohist/local` and `mohist/github-pr` both resolve `Description` via the shared resolver from their respective `WorkflowDefinition.Description`, with null/empty/whitespace falling back to "No description provided" and non-blank values trimmed of trailing whitespace.

`BuildSystemTemplates()` materializes the same description value as the profile instance's `Description` and as the `ListDescribed()` entry for each profile id; the github-pr branch no longer references the removed constant.
`IIssueWorkflowProfile` and `MohistIssueWorkflowProfileBase` declare no `SuitableFor` member; neither built-in profile overrides it.
`WorkflowProfileDescription` exposes only `Id`, `DisplayName`, `Description`; `IssueWorkflowProfileRegistry` exposes no `Matches` method; `SuitableForMatcher.cs` no longer exists.
A repo-wide grep for `SuitableFor` under packages/server returns nothing relevant (the unrelated `IssueTemplate`/`IssueTemplateRegistry` model and any test fakes are the only allowed remaining hits).

Server specs pass: `npm test` (server) is green, including repointed `MohistPrIssueWorkflowProfileSpecs` (github-pr description asserted against the YAML value) and the `/api/workflow-profiles` endpoint specs asserting no `suitableFor` field is serialized.
tasks.output: Modified server sources under packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Issue/Services/WorkflowProfiles/ (and Workflow/Services/ProjectWorkflowProfileManager.cs) with SuitableForMatcher.cs deleted, plus updated server specs; green `dotnet build Mohist.sln` and server `npm test`.
tasks.notes: Per design Decision 1, the shared resolver is the invariant that prevents re-drift between the two catalog paths. The `.TrimEnd()` normalization is a cosmetic behavior change for mohist/local (strips a trailing YAML block-scalar newline) — repointed specs assert the trimmed value. Do not touch `IssueTemplate.SuitableFor` / `IssueTemplateRegistry` (different domain concept, out of scope).

tasks.title: CLI: drop suitableFor from `mo workflow list --described` rendering and option help
tasks.description: In packages/cli, update `MohistCliApi.RenderWorkflowProfilesDescribed` to stop parsing a `suitableFor` field from the `/api/workflow-profiles` response and to stop emitting both the `Suitable for: <tags>` and `Suitable for: (not specified)` lines, so output shows only the profile id, display name, and description. Update the `--described` option help text in `MohistCliCommands.Workflow.cs` to remove the `suitable_for` wording. Update the CLI specs that asserted the `Suitable for:` output / `suitableFor` parse to assert the new description-only output.
acceptanceCriteria: `mo workflow list --described` output for a profile contains the id, display name, and description and contains no `Suitable for:` line and no `(not specified)` placeholder.
The `--described` option help text mentions no `suitable_for`.
CLI specs pass: `npm run test:run -w packages/cli` (or the repository's CLI spec command) is green, with the described-output specs updated to the description-only shape.
`RenderWorkflowProfilesDescribed` no longer references a `suitableFor` JSON field (grep returns nothing).
tasks.output: Modified packages/cli/Mohist.Cli sources (MohistCliApi render path + MohistCliCommands.Workflow.cs help text) plus updated CLI specs; green CLI spec run.
tasks.notes: Depends on T-001 because the rendered JSON no longer carries a `suitableFor` field; the CLI parse branch becomes dead once the server stops emitting it. Both ship in the same repo release.

tasks.title: Skill-data: rewrite mohist-create-issue workflow selection to default/operator choice instead of suitable_for tag matching
tasks.description: Rewrite the bundled `mohist-create-issue` skill docs (packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/skill-data/mohist-create-issue/SKILL.md and references/issue-templates.md) so workflow selection picks the default profile or an operator-chosen enabled profile id (still sourced from `mo workflow list --described`), and `recommended_workflow_reason` explains the choice in natural language. Remove all `suitable_for` tag parsing/scoring guidance and the `(not specified)` handling.
acceptanceCriteria: The `mohist-create-issue` SKILL.md and references/issue-templates.md contain no instruction to match or score profiles against `suitable_for` tags.

Workflow-selection guidance selects the default profile or an operator-chosen enabled profile id returned by `mo workflow list --described`, and `recommended_workflow_reason` is expressed in natural language rather than citing matched tags.
A grep for `suitable_for` across packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/skill-data/mohist-create-issue/ returns nothing.
tasks.output: Rewritten packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/skill-data/mohist-create-issue/ docs (SKILL.md + references/issue-templates.md) with tag-matching guidance removed.
tasks.notes: Depends on T-002 because the skill sources profile ids from `mo workflow list --described`, whose output shape is finalized by T-002. With two general-purpose defaults there is nothing meaningful to tag-score; default-or-operator-choice is the intended sole rule.
